summary: Keyed each over finding.path throws each_key_duplicate on duplicate paths; no svelte:boundary contains it, so the Находки view breaks when threats exist
evidence: VirusesPage.svelte:136; svelte each.js:357-362 duplicate-key throw in production; no svelte:boundary in apps/desktop; parser does not de-duplicate (scan.rs:36-41); lossy decoding can merge names (FND-0047)
failure_scenario: Two findings with the same path (e.g. two Cyrillic names decoded to identical U+FFFD strings): opening Находки throws. UNVERIFIED reachability.
